1.web: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
1.asv: Man, that is born of a woman, Is of few days, and full of trouble.

2.web: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
2.asv: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: He fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.

3.web: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?
3.asv: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such a one, And bringest me into judgment with thee?

4.web: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
4.asv: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

5.web: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass;
5.asv: Seeing his days are determined, The number of his months is with thee, And thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

6.web: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he shall accomplish, as a hireling, his day.
6.asv: Look away from him, that he may rest, Till he shall accomplish, as a hireling, his day.

7.web: “For there is hope for a tree, If it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.
7.asv: For there is hope of a tree, If it be cut down, that it will sprout again, And that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

8.web: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,
8.asv: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, And the stock thereof die in the ground;

9.web: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.
9.asv: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, And put forth boughs like a plant.

10.web: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?
10.asv: But man dieth, and is laid low: Yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?

11.web: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,
11.asv: Asthe waters fail from the sea, And the river wasteth and drieth up;

12.web: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they shall not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.
12.asv: So man lieth down and riseth not: Till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, Nor be roused out of their sleep.

13.web: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret, until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time, and remember me!
13.asv: Oh that thou wouldest hide me in Sheol, That thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, That thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

14.web: If a man dies, shall he live again? All the days of my warfare would I wait, until my release should come.
14.asv: If a man die, shall he liveagain? All the days of my warfare would I wait, Till my release should come.

15.web: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire to the work of your hands.
15.asv: Thou wouldest call, and I would answer thee: Thou wouldest have a desire to the work of thy hands.

16.web: But now you number my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
16.asv: But now thou numberest my steps: Dost thou not watch over my sin?

17.web: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.
17.asv: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, And thou fastenest up mine iniquity.

18.web: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place;
18.asv: But the mountain falling cometh to nought; And the rock is removed out of its place;

19.web: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.
19.asv: The waters wear the stones; The overflowings thereof wash away the dust of the earth: So thou destroyest the hope of man.

20.web: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.
20.asv: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth; Thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

21.web: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.
21.asv: His sons come to honor, and he knoweth it not; And they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.

22.web: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”
22.asv: But his flesh upon him hath pain, And his soul within him mourneth.
